value.rationale: The originating work explicitly motivates the negative-input trajectories as excitable transients and gives only a region-wise seven-step upper bound. The exact minimal horizon six and complete natural first-hitting-time stratification replace an arbitrary waiting bound with an observable deterministic clock for every initial state. A surprising coordinate-only criterion Y>-3B/2 characterizes the entire maximal-duration half-plane, while exceptional zero/one-hit strata are distinguished rigorously. This is a complete quantification of an existing natural dynamical phenomenon, not just a numerically smaller constant.
